answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks via recursive cryptographic attestation chains paired with zero-knowledge proofs, requiring each node to anchor identity within a verifiable pedigree. To deploy a swarm, an attacker faces exponential capital exhaustion: fee functions scale superlinearly, ensuring each added counterfeit hits an economic barrier as unyielding as polished marble. Rather than cracking each identity like a brittle walnut, the network turns the rising tide of verification stakes into an exponential cost wall that drowns mass spoofing.
